notes:
Improve compare report clarity and settings usability.

- Normalized Regime Usage List Business Unit ID comparisons through the resolved Business Unit name, preventing false differences when matching Business Units have environment-specific IDs.
- Replaced section-only badges like "Only in File 2" with the report/instance label so one-sided sections are easier to identify.
- Increased the Settings dialog size and made it resizable so OK and Cancel remain visible with the expanded options.
